set.body:
Outcome: a named historical video embedding/frozen-preset compatibility witness reproduces untouched c4010ed8 rendering, raw estimates, nominations, admitted states, weighted term/support/total values and LocalEvidence digest.
Scope/non-goals: embed-bench private environment-independent runner defaults and synthetic 4D ONNX engineering capture/courts; ADR0019 and evidence. Preserve strict surface half-cosine registration. No historical registration upgrade, StageTrace rewrite, new module/dependency, learned-model acquisition, corpus/private data or efficacy claim.
Invariants: historical query u.text; leaf/group embedText override including Some(empty), otherwise leaf text/group label; lexical-only extras remain separate. Raw cosine nomination, historical ID cutoff, priced semantic clamp and missing-eligible weight scaling remain explicit. Historical candidate provenance is Unattested. Prior1.5 affects transitions, not local costs. Artifact binds full fixture/preset separately from incomplete historical channel identity.
Relevant paths: embed-bench video RecallToVideo.scala/LexicalBlend.scala/RecallOrderControl.scala; channels.scala; new private HistoricalVideoDefaults.scala; test-scope fixture/capture/parity suite; align cost/contentcost/evidence reference; ADR0019.
Proposed change: shared private constants for actual runner defaults (0.8 WithLemmas/top8/no lexical overlap/scale1.5), preserve override parsing; freeze an identical synthetic harness run against untouched c4010ed8 before production edits; candidate uses actual defaults and reproduces full body/digest. Independent analytic raw-vs-half and weighted-cost assertions.
Acceptance evidence: exact endpoint/text mappings; at least9 leaves with a cutoff tie; actual alpha0.8 remaps a distinct score; selected raw cosine1/3 vs half1/6 and analytic leaf/group totals; over-one raw-distance clamp through existing historical hook; both-endpoint and all-abstained controls; full CostBreakdown/evidence membership/digest; originating LocalEvidence consumed by infer overload with legacy-infer regression comparison. Compiled named mutations for raw-to-half, override loss, default drift and eligible-weight scaling. Fatal scoped gate/consumer where referenced, formatting last, exact-SHA independent review and narrow publication.
Risks: do not call generic legacy Channel execution-attested; keep dropped failure detail/dense blend and StageTrace acceptance explicit. If preset fixtures fail to discriminate, revise before claiming parity. Red published main CI preempts new work.
Next action: begin/reserve; qualify published c4010ed8 against declared pins; run untouched-base synthetic capture, then extract defaults and implement named witness.
